normative_extracts.quote: Layout containment ensures that nothing outside the element can affect its internal layout, and nothing inside can affect the layout of anything outside.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: contain: layout establishes an independent formatting context and layout root; contain: paint clips overflow and creates a stacking context.

production_failures.symptom: contain: size collapses an accordion or card to 0px height
production_failures.root_cause: Size containment instructs the engine to size the element as if it had no children.
production_failures.mitigation: Provide explicit width/height, use contain: inline-size, or use contain: content (layout + paint + style without size).

production_failures.symptom: Dropdown menus inside a card get clipped at the card border
production_failures.root_cause: contain: paint or contain: content clips all overflowing descendants to the padding box.
production_failures.mitigation: Move floating overlays to the Top Layer with Popover API or avoid paint containment on overflow-visible containers.
